signals.text: Revenue grew 10% a year over 3 years vs 12% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 11% vs revenue at 10%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin expanded 168 bps in 3 years (26.5% → 28.2%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 120% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

guidance.statement: Management will stick to the high single-digit revenue growth guidance given at the beginning of the year.
guidance.quote: Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year.

guidance.statement: R&D spend will significantly ramp up in subsequent quarters to meet overall full year guidance.
guidance.quote: we expect the R&D spend to significantly ramp up in subsequent quarter. And our expectation is that as that ramps up, we should be able to meet the overall guidance

guidance.statement: Organon acquisition is on track to close by early 2027 or Q4 of FY27.
guidance.quote: Organon acquisition is subject to satisfaction of the remaining customary closing conditions and is on track to close by early 2027.

delivered.statement: Q2 FY27 sales were INR 1,61,000 million, registering an 11.8% growth year-on-year.
Gross margin for Q2 FY27 was 80.8%, higher than last year due to better product mix and forex.
Q2 FY27 EBITDA was INR 47,439 million with a margin of 29.3%.
India formulation sales grew 17.3% to INR 55,523 million in Q2 FY27.
Global Innovative Medicines sales increased 6.9% to reach USD 356 million.
US business reported sales of USD 455 million, declining 8.2% due to lenalidomide erosion.

calls.tone: Confident in underlying demand and strategic initiatives, despite temporary US Ilumya slowdown.

pushback.gist: Analysts repeatedly questioned the drivers behind the US Ilumya growth slowdown and recovery timelines.
Analysts questioned whether guidance would be raised given double-digit H1 growth against high single-digit guidance.
Scepticism regarding whether lower Q2 R&D spend as a percentage of sales will catch up to full-year targets.
Inquiry regarding media reports of Indian drug regulators asking Sun Pharma to halt ophthalmic production.

business.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries manufactures and markets a comprehensive basket of pharmaceutical formulations, branded generics, and global innovative medicines across multiple therapeutic areas.

segments.name: US Business
segments.note: Includes generics and specialty products in the US.

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.note: Branded generics and innovative products internationally.

guidance.statement: Acquisition-related charges for Organon are back-ended with substantial accrual at closing in early 2027.
guidance.quote: these charges are somewhat back-ended with a substantial part being accrued at closing. [...] is on track to close by early 2027.

guidance.statement: Tax rate is expected to remain in a similar range as Q1 until the Organon closing.
guidance.quote: Going forward, and until Organon closing, we expect the tax rate to be in a similar range as in Q1.

guidance.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance is maintained at high single-digit.
guidance.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year.

guidance.statement: The Organon acquisition is expected to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27.
guidance.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27 and an integration management office has been working on day one preparedness.

delivered.statement: Q1 FY27 sales grew 10.1% year-on-year to INR 1,51,836 million.
Gross margin for Q1 FY27 was higher at 80.5% due to a better product mix.
Q1 FY27 EBITDA was INR 44,177 million with an EBITDA margin of 28.9%.
Reported net profit after tax for Q1 FY27 was INR 28,948 million.
India formulation sales for Q1 FY27 grew 16% to INR 54,749 million.
U.S. business reported sales of USD 427 million for the quarter, declining by 9.7%.

calls.tone: Confident on core business and new product momentum, but cautious on macro headwinds, seasonality, and tax increases.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the slower growth momentum and flat trends in specialty medicines despite recent product launches.
Analysts pressed on whether the sharp sequential and year-on-year drop in U.S. generics represents a new sustainable base.
Analysts queried if the high single-digit revenue growth guidance was conservative given the stronger 11% Q1 performance.
Analysts questioned why employee expenses are growing faster than overall revenue despite no major field force expansion plans.

guidance.statement: We expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding.
guidance.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.

guidance.statement: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
guidance.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.

guidance.statement: We expect the Organon acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.

guidance.statement: We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
guidance.quote: Yes. We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.

delivered.statement: Q4 FY26 sales grew 13.6% YoY to INR 1,45,598 million.
Q4 FY26 gross margin was 80.8% and EBITDA margin was 27.1%.
Full year FY26 sales reached INR 582 Billion, a growth of 11.9%.
Q4 FY26 Global Innovative Medicine sales rose 20.1% to US$ 354 million.
India formulations sales were INR 48,359 million in Q4, growing 14.8%.
U.S. business reported sales of US$ 459 million for Q4, declining 1.1%.

calls.tone: confident on demand and innovative portfolio growth, cautious on near-term generic pressures and margins

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the drivers behind the sequential drop in EBITDA margins and one-off costs.
Analysts questioned the prolonged sluggishness and growth challenges in the generic medicines business.
Analysts asked if heavy discounting and formulary exclusions of branded STELARA impacted ILUMYA.
Analysts inquired about potential financial impact from recently announced US tariffs on branded drugs.

guidance.statement: Sun Pharma plans to be in market on day-one of a generic launch of Semaglutide in India.
guidance.quote: Sun Pharma plans to be in market on day-one of a generic launch.

guidance.statement: Phase-2b study for GL0034 should get over within 12 to 18 months.
guidance.quote: the current phase-2b study which has started, that should possibly get over within maybe 12-to-18 months.

delivered.statement: Recorded sales of Rs.1,54,691 million, registering a growth of 15.1% YoY.
Gross margin was at 81%, higher than the same period last year.
EBITDA was Rs.49,485 million, an increase of 23.4% over Q3 last year with 31.9% margin.
Reported net profit after tax was Rs.33,688 million, up by 16% over Q3 last year.
Global Innovative Medicines sales were up 14.3% to reach US$423 million.
India formulations sales were Rs.49,986 million, recording a growth of 16.2% over Q3 last year.

calls.tone: Optimistic on new launches and innovative medicines growth, cautious on generic pricing headwinds.

pushback.gist: Analysts probed reasons for the soft US generic performance and price erosion.
Questions raised on the declining absolute and percentage spend on innovative R&D.
Concerned if requiring genetic testing before starting LEQSELVI is a significant deterrent.
Pressed on M&A targets, debt comfort levels, and leverage limits.

guidance.statement: We aim to achieve a 35% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon emissions by 2030.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve a 35% reduction in our absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon emissions by 2030, compared to the baseline year of 2020

delivered.statement: Global consolidated revenues grew by 11.9% to ₹ 582 Billion in FY26.
EBITDA increased by 16.1% to ₹ 177 Billion, and net profit grew by 5.0% to ₹ 115 Billion.
India Formulation sales grew by 14% to ₹ 193 Billion, contributing 33% of consolidated revenues.
Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions reduced by 16.7% against baseline levels.
Approximately 52.6% of total energy consumption came from renewable energy sources.

calls.tone: Steadfast and confident, focusing on disciplined execution, portfolio balance, and sustainable growth amid a complex global environment.

bull.point: India formulations delivered strong momentum, growing 17.3% YoY to ₹55,523 million in Q2 FY27.
Exceptional financial stability with debt/equity at 0.06 and 5-year operating cash flow matching 120% of net profit.
Gross margins remained resilient at 80.8% in Q2 FY27, supported by a favorable product mix and forex gains.
Q2 FY27 sales increased 11.8% YoY to ₹161,000 million, outpacing the full-year high single-digit growth guidance.

bear.point: US business revenues declined 8.2% YoY to $455 million in Q2 FY27 due to ongoing lenalidomide price erosion.
Net profit contracted 36.2% YoY to ₹1,995 crore in the Sep 2026 quarter.
Analysts raised concerns regarding growth deceleration in US Ilumya and generic medicine pricing headwinds.
R&D spending lagged targets, requiring a heavy ramp-up in H2 FY27 to achieve full-year guidance.

watch: Organon acquisition closing timeline and accrued transaction charges in Q4 FY27.
US Ilumya sales performance and recovery momentum in global specialty medicines.
R&D spend ramp-up in H2 FY27 toward 6%-7% of sales guidance.
